subject: Legal Studies

internalBreakdown.component: Project: Understanding Case Laws (three decided cases: civil, criminal, constitutional)

notes: No chapter-level learning outcomes are given; course competencies: identify legal issues, apply law, legal research, legal values.

chapters.name: Judiciary
topics: Structure, hierarchy of courts and legal officers
Appointment, retirement and removal of judges

chapters.name: Alternative Dispute Resolution
topics: Lok Adalat; ombudsman; Lokpal and Lokayukta

chapters.name: Law of Contract
topics: Discharge of contract; remedies for breach

chapters.name: Law of Property
topics: Who can transfer; essentials of a valid transfer

chapters.name: Intellectual Property Law
topics: International obligations shaping Indian IPR; WIPO
Copyright, patent, trademark, geographical indication, design

chapters.name: Law and Sustainable Development
topics: Environment Protection Act 1986; Pollution Control Boards

chapters.name: Forms of Legal Entities
topics: Private and public limited company; one person company

chapters.name: Criminal Laws in India
topics: Intention and motive; stages of crime
Indian Evidence Act; admission and confession

chapters.name: Human Rights in India
topics: Preamble, fundamental rights, directive principles, fundamental duties

chapters.name: Human Rights Violations: Complaint Mechanism (Quasi-Judicial Bodies)
topics: NHRC, National Commission for Minorities, NCW, National Commission for SC and ST, NCPCR

chapters.name: International Law
topics: International and municipal law; international law and India

chapters.name: Legal Profession in India
topics: Liberalisation and globalisation of the profession; women in law
Legal education in India, USA and UK; opportunities for law graduates

chapters.name: Legal Services
topics: Free legal aid under criminal law; legal aid by the state and under the Constitution
Legal aid, social justice and human rights
